Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 26a (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and the sections for the files below. Edit ONLY: tools/autopilot-lock.mjs, tools/chief-orchestrator.mjs, tools/journal.mjs, tools/ledger-lease.mjs, tools/ledger-merge.mjs, tools/gpu-bakeoff.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, or exports. No refactors or reformatting.

Line numbers below are CURRENT (verified against origin/swarm/train3). For each listed catch, bind the error and do exactly what the line says:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>' (or the named class, e.g. SyntaxError); console.error anything else. Keep the same fallback value.
- LEAVE: make NO change to that catch at all.
- LOG-ALWAYS: console.error unconditionally, include the path/id named, keep the same fallback value.
- For `.catch(() => null)` / `.catch(() => '')` forms, keep returning the same value from inside the new handler.
- A close/cleanup inside an error path that rethrows: log the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT binding name; the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/autopilot-lock.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/autopilot-lock.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 57 `} catch { /* already gone */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — release path of the autopilot lock. Stay silent on ENOENT (already gone). If error is a SyntaxError log the fixed text 'corrupt autopilot lock (SyntaxError)' (NEVER error.message). Any other code: console.error with the lock path.

### tools/chief-orchestrator.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/chief-orchestrator.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 52 `} catch { /* already gone */ }`: SILENT-ENOENT — release path of the chief lock. Stay silent on ENOENT (already gone). If error is a SyntaxError log the fixed text 'corrupt chief lock (SyntaxError)' (NEVER error.message). Any other code: console.error with the lock path.

### tools/journal.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/journal.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 284 `fs.unlink(lock).catch(() => {})`: LOG-ALWAYS except ENOENT — releasing the journal write lock in finally; a failed unlink leaves a stale lock. Silent on ENOENT, console.error anything else with the lock path. Do not rethrow.

### tools/ledger-lease.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/ledger-lease.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 136 `handle.close().catch(() => {})`: LOG-CLEANUP — this cleanup runs inside an error path that rethrows: bind the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT name than the outer error and console.error it (always); the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/ledger-merge.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/ledger-merge.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 162 `handle.close().catch(() => {})`: LOG-CLEANUP — this cleanup runs inside an error path that rethrows: bind the cleanup error with a DIFFERENT name than the outer error and console.error it (always); the original error must still be rethrown unchanged.

### tools/gpu-bakeoff.mjs
Logger prefix: console.error('[tools/gpu-bakeoff.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)
- Line 137 `replica?.stop() catch { /* dead-man timer removes it */ }`: LOG-ALWAYS — fails to stop a paid per-hour GPU replica; the dead-man timer is a backstop, not a reason to hide a failed stop that could leak paid compute.

Do NOT touch any other catch. FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
